research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12296 (46 FR 15129, PDF page 7 of the 1981-03-04 issue; sha256 f78c50d0...), headed Executive Order 12296 of March 2, 1981, President's Economic Policy Advisory Board, matching the census register row (1981-03-02). Text and inventory: ten clauses (sections 1, 1(b), 2, 2(b), 2(c), 3, 3(b), 3(c), 4, 4(b)) cover sections 1 through 4 to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory board. Own terms: section 4(b) ends the Board on December 31, 1982 unless sooner extended; the held continuance orders 12399, 12489, 12534 and 12610 each continue it, so the fixed date did not end it. Ending: Executive Order 12692 section 3(e) revokes the order as amended by Executive Order 12309, effective September 30, 1989; section 4 of that order supersedes Executive Order 12610, the last continuance. Whether Executive Order 12610 continued the Board exactly to September 30, 1989 cannot be read in the registered text (the year is illegible); if it did, the inclusive reading of that date ends the continuance the same day, so the first-end date does not change. Original grade: Federal Register machine text.

savings.reason: Executive Order 12692 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the President's Economic Policy Advisory Board: its section 1 continues other committees, its section 2 reassigns Federal Advisory Committee Act functions only for those other committees, and its section 3 revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the Commission.
